items.title: ggml/llama.cpp releases: v0.7.0
items.description:
## Overview

llama.cpp v0.7.0 adds the LiliCorr speculative decoding technique and MTP for GLM5-Next, a new GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (`--moe-cache-mib`, up to ~2.2x decode speedup when experts are offloaded), and a large batch of new models: K2 Horizon (dense and MoVA), Prism
items.summary: llama.cpp v0.7.0 introduces LiliCorr speculative decoding, MTP for GLM5-Next, and a GPU cache for MoE experts, significantly boosting decode speed, while adding several new models like K2 Horizon and Prism.
